gloss: this guy; this person; this thing (rough/informal)

definitions.explanation: an informal or rough pronoun referring to a person near the speaker
used informally to refer to an object or situation near the speaker

examples.japanese: こいつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧だ。
こいつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{困|こま}らされた。
こいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧{奴|やつ}だ。
examples.english: This guy is an interesting fellow.

examples.japanese: こいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
こいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厄介|やっかい}→厄介：03640_yakkai⟧だな。

examples.english: I need to do something about this.

notes:
REGISTER:
Informal/rough. Can be contemptuous when referring to people.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM:
Part of the demonstrative pronoun system:
- こいつ (this - near speaker)
- ⟦そいつ→そいつ：08759_soitsu⟧ (that - near listener)
- ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧ (that - distant)
- ⟦どいつ→どいつ：18614_doitsu⟧ (which - interrogative)

WRITING:
Can be written {此奴|こいつ} but usually in hiragana.

SENSE 2 (Things/Situations):
Commonly used in casual speech for objects, problems, or situations.

POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (this person)
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ (this thing - neutral)
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (this person - formal)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧ (that guy)
- ⟦そいつ→そいつ：08759_soitsu⟧ (that guy)
- ⟦どいつ→どいつ：18614_doitsu⟧ (which guy)
- {奴|やつ} (guy, fellow)
